column4: Profile swap is documented and done before. THE CHECK THAT CANNOT DRIFT: after `minikube start`, `diff <(jq -S . ~/.minikube/profiles/minikube/config.json) <(jq -S . ~/.minikube/profiles/<new>/config.json)` MUST come back empty. A new profile is CREATED IDENTICAL to the default - every creation flag, not just memory/cpu (--gpus all, --mount-string /usr/lib/wsl:/usr/lib/wsl, --extra-config=kubelet.cgroup-driver=systemd, --disk-size, --base-image, same addon set); the empty diff is what PROVES it, so run it rather than trusting this flag list (that assumption was the #231 GPU bug). .wslconfig is never a cap; existing profiles are resized with docker update + config.json.
The operator install order and image list are already scripted; the CSA/Flink helm block is commented out in the installer and must be enabled for Flink work.

cso-operator-app is live prod: read its own CLAUDE.md in that repo first; read the RUNNING pod's MODULES before any deploy (a bare deploy.sh silently drops RAG/Streamers); every redeploy needs a live NiFi flow-state check AND a fresh ask.
flink-agents (#231) built and ran on cso-prod-1: image 0.3.1, FlinkDeployment STABLE, destroy path proven. Start from those files.

Parameter Context inheritance (#203) is validated: base cluster-creds → child contexts; enc{} in flow.json never proves a literal — check referencingComponents; never GET-then-PUT a processor with sensitive properties.

Adding/updating a PG without touching the root flow is skill rule 10 + flow-registry.md (upload, upsert = stop→drain→delete→reimport, param pre-create from Secrets). NEVER delete+reimport a live PG that already has sensitive Parameter Context values — the reimport blanks them (flow JSON exports sensitive params as null); for an additive change use targeted API POSTs against the live PG, never delete+reimport — flow-registry.md Step 2B warning box (#319). Re-export the checked-in flow after any live edit. Positions are baked into the uploaded JSON, so run layout.md's pre-flight (shape, pitch, branch spacing) BEFORE building the flow you upload — rule 5's inline-position guard can't see them (SparkLlmBridge #226/#238, 2026-08-27).

EFM agent enrollment: only the Deploy Agent CLI screen or POST /efm/api/agent-deployer/generateCommand (omit agentIdentifier). Never hand-build the command, never reuse an identifier. Flow Designer API is reverse-engineered in the same reference.

Custom NiFi processors: PVC not minikube mount, NiFi must be 2.x, rebuild→redeploy discipline, mixed-template EL trap — all written up. Prefer a FlowFile chain of native processors over one monolithic Python processor.
Kafka on the CSO cluster: the 3-broker yaml is in files/cso-prod-1; topic delete/retention-flush via the CLI does not work here — use the Surveyor UI.
Prometheus/Grafana on this cluster and the EFM/NiFi metrics relay are built and documented; EFM lastSeen is not liveness — the heartbeat counter is.
Sparkplug B / MQTT: Mosquitto runs in the mqtt namespace behind a zellij pane AND a Windows Firewall rule (both needed for LAN devices); MicroFi flows are exported in files/.

AMOLED board work is closed; those two docs are authoritative (backends :8091-:8094, fonts round DOWN off-ladder, shell is littlefs data). Build the simulator before the first flash; flashing COM8 needs no ask.
NvidiaNano (Jetson Orin Nano) setup, MiNiFi ops and inference are documented; it is reached by SSH proxy from WindowsDesktop and has its own device label.
GetIceberg (#154) and QueryIceberg (#156) NARs are built and validated on WindowsDesktop; pushdown proven; catalog.* prefix and cast-unwrap gotchas are in the plan docs.

.wslconfig is a setting Steven owns, not a hardware cap: never downsize a cluster or drop stack components to fit it. New profile sizing = the default profile's config.json; completed/cso-prod-1-preprod-plan.md §4 carries the current numbers AND the jq-diff that PROVES a new profile matches the default — run that diff rather than trusting a sizing number pasted here (a hardcoded number is exactly what drifts).

k3s on the DGX Spark is built and scripted: pinned v1.32.13+k3s1 under the CSA/CSM 1.32 ceiling, nvidia RuntimeClass auto-created, device plugin needs the nvidia.com/gpu.present label; the whole operator install is one idempotent script.

The Spark box's local KB is BUILT (Qdrant :6333 + TEI :8080 nomic 768-d, collection desktopshare-kb): query it with the ds-kb kb_search MCP tool instead of re-deriving. files/issue-226/kb/ingest.py rebuilds; files/issue-226/kb/reindex.sh runs from checkin.sh on changed paths, spark-dd06 only. Index with the nomic 'search_document: ' prefix, query with 'search_query: '; never index into my-rag-collection. Validator (validator.py, guard.sh rule 10.5, advisory/spark-dd06-only) and measure.py (§5 study) are built — the box model MUST run enable_thinking:false or a verdict is null/~25s.

EFM Flow Designer API is reverse-engineered in minifi-efm.md §7: every write hangs off /designer/flows/{flowId}/..., revision.version is ALWAYS 0 on create (independent per component), get the controller-service bundle from a working example (StandardHttpContextMap = nifi-http-context-map-nar), one POST per processor + one per connection (no bulk, no whole-flow PUT), GET .../validate clean before POST .../publish. Set the position to the EFM pitch (row 300 / branch 600-900, vertical chain) per layout.md BEFORE the create call.

Published prose is measured against the blog-voice band with files/prose-lint.py (em-dash <=2/k, proof-words <=3/k, colon-joins <=10/k; sentence length is NOT the gap): lint before and after any rewrite, one commit per chapter, before/after row in the finish comment. The A/B (2026-09-08) picked rules-only, so writing-style.md + those three thresholds are the whole bar; no second-person/first-person rubric.

On WindowsDesktop the live `!load … screen2` path is central NiFi → the native MiNiFi JAVA agent (HandleHttpRequest :8082) → ExecuteStreamCommand windows_screen_control.py mpv-load screen2; mpv_stream_launcher.py :5902 and browser_launcher.py :5901 are vestigial there. The agent must run in the interactive Session 1 (a Session-0 launch opens an invisible mpv that still holds the pipe). Verify a screen fix with a real `!load`/`s2` or a POST to :8082, never :5902 (2026-09-07, #307).

Headless UI capture is scripted: `node files/headless-shot.mjs <out-dir/prefix> <url> [click-label …]` drives chromium over CDP (clicks SPA tabs a URL can't reach, writes the PNG from node — snap chromium's own --screenshot cannot write to /tmp). Output goes in files/issue-<n>/ and the PNG is embedded in the issue comment; never under ~/Downloads (2026-09-08, #302). Grafana/EFM/NiFi route notes are in the script header.

A full AMOLED platform build is ~10 min and Steven's call (guard 15 asks). An app or shell change is the ~20 s littlefs path: stage with tools/stage_apps.py (--shell for the launcher) and write-flash 0xaa1000 littlefs_data.bin — 0x60000 is the C++ app firmware only, flashing it never changes the splash/shell. Two boards plugged in = two parallel builds in separate BROOKESIA_DIR work trees, never serialized.

Memories are device-local facts only, approved one by one through files/memory-propose.sh (opens a new proposal issue → Steven's yes at write time); a session never saves one on its own and guard M denies the write. Feedback/lessons go issue → incident (agent/incident-rules.md) → a new issue summarizing the triggering event (#247 retired as the funnel 2026-09-09); device facts go in CLAUDE-CHECKIN.md. The per-device optimize procedure is local-repo-unification.md (#310).

The X live pipeline on WindowsDesktop is built (~/mediamtx, runbook ~/livestream.md): ffmpeg ddagrab capture → MediaMTX :1935 → relay to X; key from Media Studio, not the API. "Stop" = all four layers including mediamtx; pkill -f self-matches — use bracket patterns. Facts in the WindowsDesktop block of CLAUDE-CHECKIN.md.

The 2026-09-08 perf pass (#312) already mapped this box's memory: what is scaled to 0 and why, the vLLM restart order (whisper→0, vLLM 0→1, wait for the API, whisper→1), Prometheus re-stand path, and the Windows/WSL keep-vs-cut list. Read it before shedding or restoring anything.
